slices.title: Read the host `answers[]` ask details in `_shared/ask-answers.ts`: timedOut gating, note pairing, blank-answer skipping, schema tied to `AskToolDetails`
slices.done_when: `SRC=<PR checkout> bun /tmp/a4-ask.ts` exits 0 with `native` = "Database → SQLite\nBackfill → no", `notes` = that first line plus " [note: SQLite — only if backups stay] [note: SQLite — and WAL on]", `timedOut`/`blankAnswer`/`emptyAnswers` null, `notTimedOut` = "Backfill → no", `persisted` = [native] and the legacy/other/error readings unchanged (rows 1–5), and `bun run check && bun run test` exits 0 with the `answers[]` schema annotated `zod.ZodLikeSchema<AskToolDetails>` from `@oh-my-pi/pi-tui/tools/ask` so a host shape change is a type error rather than another silent null (row 6).

open_points.point: Whether a whitespace-only `answer` ("   ") counts as 空白 and is skipped: the decision row 「原生答案为空时的表现」 says 空白答案按未作答跳过, while its evidence only fixes `answer: ""` as 未作答 (宿主 `formAnswers` 对没填的字段写 `answer: ""`), so both readings are allowed and they differ when it is the only entry.
outputs: null — whitespace counts as blank, is skipped, and it is the only entry
"Backfill →    " — only the empty string counts as blank, so the spaces pass through as the answer text
open_points.producer: node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-tui/src/html-form/data.ts:245-247 (`answerText` returns `String(value)` untrimmed) for the text field built at node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-tui/src/html-form/parse.ts:553-558; the submitted value passes through `textValue` at node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-tui/src/html-form/data.ts:70-76 untrimmed, and the model authors the form (`params.html`, node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent/src/tools/ask.ts:453)
open_points.searched: Read `formAnswers` (data.ts:230-243), `answerText` (245-254), `textValue` (70-76), `fieldQuestions` (138-149) and the text-control branch (parse.ts:553-558); ran parseHtmlForm+formAnswers from the base checkout's host packages on `<label>Backfill <input type="text" name="ticks" value="no"></label>` with data `{ticks:"   "}` → `[{"name":"ticks","question":"Backfill","answer":"   "}]`.

open_points.point: Two `answers[]` entries can carry the same `name` and `question` (two same-named text controls, neither labeled); 结果 1 says each answered question occupies one line of `formatAskAnswers`, which allows either one line per entry or one deduplicated line.
outputs: "x → v\nx → v" — one line per `answers[]` entry
"x → v" — one line per distinct answered question
open_points.producer: node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-tui/src/html-form/data.ts:230-243 emits one `FormAnswer` per `form.fields` entry, and node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-tui/src/html-form/parse.ts:553-558 adds one text field per control without deduplicating the name (only radios/checkboxes group, parse.ts:530-551)
open_points.searched: Read the control→field mapping and `formAnswers`; ran parseHtmlForm+formAnswers on `<input type="text" name="x">` twice, unlabeled → two fields and `[{"name":"x","question":"x","answer":"v"},{"name":"x","question":"x","answer":"v"}]`.

open_points.point: A `textarea` answer keeps its newlines, so `formatAskAnswers` would put one answered question on several physical lines although the contract fixes 每个作答问题一行 and only rules whitespace folding for note text.
outputs: "Notes → line one\nline two" — the answer text is passed through as the host wrote it
"Notes → line one line two" — the one-line-per-question rule collapses whitespace in the answer as it does in note text
open_points.producer: node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-tui/src/html-form/parse.ts:500-507 builds a `textarea` field with `multiline: true`, and node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-tui/src/html-form/data.ts:245-247 returns `String(value)` unchanged
open_points.searched: Read the textarea branch and `answerText`, plus `fieldQuestions` (data.ts:138-149, which applies `oneLine` to questions only, so only answers can carry newlines); ran parseHtmlForm+formAnswers on `<label>Notes <textarea name="notes">draft</textarea></label>` with `{notes:"line one\nline two"}` → `[{"name":"notes","question":"Notes","answer":"line one\nline two"}]`.

gate_gaps.row: 结果 3 — 没有 `notes`、备注全部配不上、或备注文本折叠后为空时，输出与结果 1 相同 (all-notes-unmatched branch)
gate_gaps.input: {"toolName":"ask","isError":false,"details":{"answers":[{"name":"db","question":"Database","answer":"SQLite"},{"name":"ticks","question":"Backfill","answer":"no"}],"notes":[{"name":"gone","question":"Removed","option":"Other","value":"other","text":"orphan note"}]}} — the script only mixes one orphan note with two matching ones, so it cannot show that an all-unmatched `notes` array leaves the output equal to `native`.

gate_gaps.row: 结果 3 / 决策表「宿主的 `notes`（选项备注）去向」— 备注文本折叠后为空的不并入
gate_gaps.input: {"toolName":"ask","isError":false,"details":{"answers":[{"name":"db","question":"Database","answer":"SQLite"}],"notes":[{"name":"db","question":"Database","option":"SQLite","value":"sqlite","text":" \n\t "}]}} — expect "Database → SQLite" with no bracket; neither fixture note collapses to empty. (The form dialog already drops such notes at node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-tui/src/html-form/dialog.ts:449, so this branch has no live host producer.)

gate_gaps.row: 决策表「宿主的 `notes`（选项备注）去向」— 与回答按 `name` 和 `question` 同时相同配对
gate_gaps.input: {"toolName":"ask","isError":false,"details":{"answers":[{"name":"db","question":"Database","answer":"SQLite"}],"notes":[{"name":"db","question":"Something else","option":"SQLite","value":"sqlite","text":"near miss"},{"name":"other","question":"Database","option":"SQLite","value":"sqlite","text":"other near miss"}]}} — expect "Database → SQLite" with neither note; the fixture's orphan differs in both fields, so pairing on only one of them would still pass row 3.

gate_gaps.row: 结果 4 [保持] — 两种形状都不成立的 `details` 仍返回 `null`
gate_gaps.input: `{"toolName":"ask","isError":false,"details":{}}` and `{"toolName":"ask","isError":false,"details":{"results":"nope"}}` — the script feeds `otherTool`/`errorResult` only with the host shape and `legacyNoSelection` only with a legacy shape, so no reading observes a `details` that fits neither shape.

gate_gaps.row: 结果 1、结果 2 — turn-judge `before()` 的 `用户在ask中回答` 条目与 `livePrompts()` 的 `{{ask_answers}}` 渲染
gate_gaps.input: A session branch whose tool results are `{"toolName":"ask","isError":false,"details":{"answers":[{"name":"db","question":"Database","answer":"SQLite"}]}}` and `{"toolName":"ask","isError":false,"details":{"answers":[{"name":"ticks","question":"Backfill","answer":"no"}],"timedOut":true}}`, read through agent/extensions/turn-judge/index.ts:565 and agent/extensions/user-prompt-inject/index.ts:301 — no acceptance command calls either consumer (the driver only reads the persisted path, transcript.ts:308-315 and 349-359); the tree's overall acceptance issue #337 is what observes these two surfaces in a real session.
